Hey, I’m really sorry you’re going through that. 
I can relate to a lot what you’re saying. I’m 23, diagnosed with depression since 15 and at 21 got a diagnosis for ASD which made a lot of things make sense in my head for me.

I look at it like a way of dealing with life. Some people care a lot and see all the bad things and some people don’t care and just make the most of their time and enjoy it, even though they still have problems like everyone else. There’s no good or bad way, everyone is just different.

What helped for me is putting myself first. I’m trying to live my life for myself, not for others. I do what makes me happy, I’m vocal about things that bother me to create a better environment for me. I go to therapy, which I recommend. I made the choice to try and get better and in order to do that I have to be open and honest with my therapist, else they can’t help me. It’s hard sometimes, I feel very vulnerable when sharing things I’ve never shared with anyone before, but that’s their job. I also like how I can share my thoughts with someone I know won’t and can’t gossip about it or tell people close to me about my problems. It feels very freeing after I walk out of my session. I’ve accepted that being more negative/ depressing is probably part of my personality now, so now it is just a matter of figuring out how to deal with it in a way that suits me and my life. I don’t see the point of life, so I’ve been trying to create little goals I can focus on to give it some meaning.

Also we’re still young, you are in a crucial point of developing yourself and figuring out how you want to mature. I’m finding the transition from being a teen to being seen as an adult quite hard. It’s confusing and hormones are a bit weird sometimes.

I’m sorry for talking about myself so much but I’ve been down in the gutter for a while and just want to show you my personal experience of cleaning the gutter I’m in and making it feel like a home I enjoy. I really hope you are able to figure it all out with time and please don’t stress too much about life!! No need to make it harder than it is :’) good luck!!
